milestones.title: M0 — Product blueprint
milestones.description: Source-backed requirements, architecture, testing, App Store compliance and issue-based delivery workflow.

milestones.title: M1 — Native foundation
milestones.description: Versioned Swift-native sandboxed macOS app, repeatable tests and CI universal archives.

milestones.title: M2 — Tabs and reliable recovery
milestones.description: End-to-end tab editing with no-confirmation quit and durable restart recovery.

milestones.title: M3 — Safe file workflows
milestones.description: Sandboxed open/save, lossless supported encodings, bookmarks and external conflict protection.

milestones.title: M4 — Complete editing experience
milestones.description: Search, navigation, display preferences, printing and recoverable tab management.

milestones.title: M5 — Release quality
milestones.description: Crash/failure tests, measured speed, accessibility and supported OS/architecture validation.

milestones.title: M6 — App Store and v1.0.0
milestones.description: Signed TestFlight candidate, public store assets/policies, review and first production GitHub release.

issues.title: Document product research, architecture and delivery roadmap
acceptance: Research Windows 11 Notepad using dated primary sources and distinguish Insider announcements from universal availability.
Commit PRD, TDD, AGENTS.md, implementation plan, TESTING.md, App Store matrix and release/versioning policy.
Create end-to-end milestones, dependency-linked issues, PR/issue templates and contributor workflow.
Validate documentation links and record unresolved publisher/distribution decisions.

issues.title: Create versioned Swift 6 native macOS app foundation
acceptance: Commit reproducible XcodeGen specification and generated Xcode project with AppKit app plus Foundation core package.
Set macOS 14 deployment target, Swift 6 concurrency, version 0.1.0/build 1 and universal release architectures.
Enable App Sandbox and hardened runtime; include minimal entitlements and accurate privacy manifest.
Build native editable shell and unit-test core model invariants; document exact build commands.
Keep foundation-only behavior clearly marked as development status.

issues.title: Add CI validation and unsigned archive delivery pipelines
acceptance: Every PR and main push runs formatting/config checks, core tests and macOS app build.
Produce and inspect unsigned optimized universal archives with log retention; use a manually dispatchable delivery workflow.
Pin third-party Actions by full SHA; use least-privilege permissions, concurrency limits and no PR secrets.
Add dependency update automation and configure available main branch enforcement; record plan restrictions.
Verify actual GitHub runs and artifact output before merging.

issues.title: Implement versioned atomic recovery storage and failure tests
acceptance: Persist complete validated workspace snapshots with schema version, checksum and atomic publication.
Serialize writes and reject stale revisions; keep a known-good fallback generation.
Recover after primary corruption without deleting evidence; reject future schemas without overwriting files.
Return explicit errors for write/permission failures and invalid state; never treat an unreadable store as first launch.
Test round trips, corrupted/truncated data, fallback, future schemas, stale writes and injected failures.
Document full-snapshot performance limitations pending issue 12.

issues.title: Integrate tabs with continuous recovery and prompt-free shutdown
acceptance: Create/select/switch tabs with per-tab text storage and undo; preserve active text selection and scroll.
Checkpoint using debounce plus maximum interval and flush latest edits on Cmd+Q/red window close.
Exit without unsaved-file confirmation; restore tabs, edits, order, active selection and window frame.
Show persistent nonmodal recovery errors with retry/export and safe future-schema behavior.
Verify immediate-edit-then-quit, repeated quit and pending-write races via integration/UI tests.

issues.title: Add native open/save and lossless text format support
acceptance: Implement native open/save/save-as panels, multiple-file opening, Finder requests and duplicate-tab detection.
Round-trip UTF-8/BOM and BOM-marked UTF-16 LE/BE; preserve mixed newlines exactly.
Reject invalid/binary data and files exceeding documented limits before large allocations.
Perform cancellable background reads and atomic coordinated writes; failed saves retain dirty state.
Verify Unicode, RTL, emojis, long lines and filename/extension behavior.

issues.title: Protect sandbox file access and external edit conflicts
acceptance: Persist/resolve scoped bookmarks with balanced access and stale refresh.
Detect deleted/moved/revoked files without losing recovery buffers; offer relink/Save As.
Compare file identity/content before save and require explicit conflict resolution.
Verify real signed sandbox behavior across folders and external/unavailable volumes.
Ensure explicit save is the only original-file write path.

issues.title: Complete find/replace, navigation and editor status
acceptance: Native search, next/previous, case options, replace/replace-all and go-to-line work with Unicode.
Show accurate line/column, selection/character counts, encoding and newline information.
Use standard Mac shortcuts and preserve per-tab undo/selection.
Keep counting/search work responsive on large files; test empty and no-match cases.

issues.title: Add fonts, appearance, wrap, zoom, spelling and printing
acceptance: Native font family/face/size, system/light/dark theme, word wrap and zoom/reset persist across launch.
Display settings never modify text bytes or saved encoding.
Optional spelling; automatic quote/dash replacements off by default; IME remains intact.
Native print/page setup uses the chosen content and readable pagination.
Verify localizable strings and keyboard access to settings.

issues.title: Add tab reordering and recently closed recovery
acceptance: Reorder tabs by pointer and keyboard; persist order and keep selection stable.
Close tab without destructive prompt; retain 20 recent tabs and provide Reopen Closed Tab.
Provide explicit clear-history action and safe post-commit cleanup.
Accessible tab names, dirty indicators, focus and overflow behavior with 100 tabs.

issues.title: Build end-to-end lifecycle and fault-injection test suite
issues.requirements: All functional requirements, especially NH-02 to NH-08
acceptance: Run isolated XCUITests covering normal quit, red close, restart, tabs, undo, files and preferences.
Add child-process force-kill tests around recovery commit phases and continuous input.
Inject storage failure, corrupt generations and migration/future-schema fixtures.
Attach evidence of no source-file overwrites on quit and no recovery success after failure.
Make deterministic tests required CI checks and triage all discovered data-loss bugs.

issues.title: Optimize recovery and validate performance budgets
acceptance: Replace hot-path full-workspace snapshots with immutable changed-tab blobs and atomic manifest commits.
Preserve migration, fallback and failure invariants under fault-injection tests.
Measure 20-run median/p95 startup, restoration, typing and tab switching on recorded baseline hardware.
Measure memory/idle energy and large-file behavior; attach Instruments findings.
Meet budgets or explicitly revise product limits with evidence; remove unverified speed claims.

issues.title: Validate accessibility, Unicode and platform compatibility
acceptance: Manual VoiceOver/full-keyboard/contrast/reduced-motion validation with evidence.
Verify Urdu/RTL, emoji, combining marks, Japanese/Chinese IME and per-tab undo.
Run on macOS 14 and current stable macOS, Apple silicon and Intel before claiming both supported.
Exercise multiple displays, resize, dark mode, fresh install and upgrade.
Record all untested combinations as release blockers, not passed checks.

issues.title: Configure signed archive and TestFlight delivery
acceptance: Confirm seller/team, reserve bundle ID and create App Store Connect app record.
Configure scoped environment secrets, temporary signing keychain/profile cleanup and protected delivery workflow.
Validate signature, universal binary, entitlements, privacy report and quarantine-free archive.
Enforce matching marketing version and monotonically increasing uploaded build number.
Upload and install a real TestFlight build; document required publisher configuration without secrets.

issues.title: Prepare original branding, public policies and store metadata
issues.requirements: NH-13 and App Store metadata/legal gates
acceptance: Create original icon and accurate screenshots from final UI; no Microsoft assets.
Publish public HTTPS support and privacy pages accessible without GitHub login.
Complete description, keywords, category, age/privacy/accessibility/export answers and reviewer notes.
Confirm copyright/seller, pricing, territories and applicable trader declarations with publisher.
Recheck current Apple review requirements and attach completed readiness matrix.

issues.title: Ship v1.0.0 through App Review and GitHub Releases
acceptance: Close release blockers and attach full test/performance/accessibility/signing evidence for exact candidate commit.
Bump release version/build in its own PR; prepare changelog and upgrade/recovery rollback plan.
Submit tested candidate and correct metadata to App Review; resolve actual review findings.
Create v1.0.0 tag and draft GitHub release from approved source; publish when launch gates pass.
Link Mac App Store listing; do not distribute unsigned CI archives as production downloads.
